user.title: Connect Sdui
user.description:
Timetable, substitutions and cancellations from Sdui in Home Assistant.

First find your school, then log in with your usual Sdui credentials.

data_description.school: Name or city of the school, e.g. “Goethe” or “Stuttgart” (at least 3 characters).

school.title: Choose your school
school.description: {count} result(s) for “{term}”. Not listed? Go back and try another search term.

credentials.title: Log in to Sdui
credentials.description:
**{school}**

Use the same credentials as in the Sdui app or on sdui.app. The password is stored in Home Assistant so that the login can be renewed automatically.

students.title: Choose students
students.description: Each student gets a device with a timetable calendar and sensors for lessons, substitutions and school start/end.

data_description.extra_ids: Only needed if a student is missing: the number in the address of the timetable on sdui.app (…/timetable/users/1234567). Separate several ids with commas.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Sdui again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for **{account}** has expired or is no longer valid. Please enter your Sdui credentials again.

data_description.slink: Slink of the school (part of the address of its Sdui login page, e.g. my-school).

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Please check username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Sdui cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.no_students: Please select at least one student.
error.invalid_student: No access to the timetable of an entered id. Please check the id.
error.school_not_found: No school found. Try another part of the name or the city.

abort.already_configured: This Sdui account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Sdui account.
